title: Clipping through Mall World?
content: After posting about my most recent trip to Mall World where I found what I believe to be the security code to access the mall after hours, I was surfing this reddit and found a post about a grocery world that re-awakened a memory of a dream I had. One that terrified me. A bunch of us were organizing a field trip. Us adults were all wearing white t shirts with black numbers on them. We were supervising a group of kids to their first trip to the mall, but first we were going to stop at the grocery store. The grocery store looked remarkably like a Weiss Markets. If you live in southeastern Pennsylvania, you might have memories of one. Anyway we were all walking the kids to the grocery store when one of us, a strong athletic adult named Steve (he was wearing number 08) began to sink down into parking lot. We all watched in horror as he waved his arms and let out this terrible gurgle / scream as he sank entirely below the surface. One of our group cried out, "Damn it, he's clipping! Everyone, focus on something real in front of you!" For those unfamiliar with the term, "clipping" is a glitch that happens in a video game where your character can pass through physical boundaries they shouldn't be able to, boundaries like floors, ceilings, and walls. After a while, we hurriedly got the kids into the grocery store. One of our group came up to me said, "Don't worry about Steve. He's okay and he said he can still see and hear us, just we can't interact with him because he clipped through to a different world.". I asked how is that possible? The group member said, "Happens all the time. If you're not careful with your thoughts, your thinking can break the world reality you're in and you clip. It even happens in the other world. People go missing and they're never found. They clipped." Woke up right after that.
